name: Milton Sheaf
summary: In Stormwind Keep, Milton Sheaf guards the kingdom's written history. He tends the Royal Library and calls on Alliance travelers to recover lost books and records.

sections.title: The Caretaker of Stormwind's History
sections.body: Milton Sheaf tends the Royal Library inside Stormwind Keep. While the court handles politics, noble disputes, and military concerns, he preserves the written record. He sees accurate histories of the Alliance and the Eastern Kingdoms as a duty, especially amid war, loss, and instability.

sections.title: Recovering Lost Tomes
sections.body: Milton Sheaf sends travelers to recover books scattered across the realm. Volumes wear with use, while records lie in monastic archives, distant outposts, and forgotten ruins. He sends Alliance adventurers from Northshire Abbey to Southshore in the north to retrieve misplaced books, examine ancient texts, and return rare manuscripts safely to the keep.

faq.answer: Milton Sheaf is a human scholar who cares for the Royal Library inside Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City. He manages the kingdom's books and chronicles.

faq.q: Where can I find Milton Sheaf?
faq.answer: You can find Milton Sheaf in the Royal Library wing of Stormwind Keep, just off the main palace corridors.

faq.q: Why does Milton Sheaf need adventurers?
faq.answer: Milton Sheaf relies on traveling Alliance adventurers to find historical manuscripts, replace damaged books, and work with scholars and priests across the kingdom to grow the Royal Library's archives.

faq.q: Does Milton Sheaf interact with other scholars in the kingdom?
faq.answer: Yes. Milton Sheaf keeps ties with monastic archivists and religious scholars, including Brother Paxton in Northshire Valley, to preserve sacred teachings and historical records.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you can help Milton Sheaf preserve the recorded heritage of the human kingdoms and the wider Alliance.
As a human, you share a history Milton Sheaf safeguards, preserving chronicles that survived Stormwind's fall and rebuilding.
